content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My smart thermostat ups the temperature when I merely think ‘warmer’.
Smart thermostats adjust with schedules, occupancy sensors, and learned preferences. Any eco/auto-learning modes active?
Auto-schedule and presence detection are on.
Those can raise setpoints when motion or time windows trigger. Do app logs show automatic adjustments at the moments you noticed?
There are entries marked ‘auto’ around those times.
Auto entries tied to routine windows indicate learned behavior rather than thought-based control.
So it’s reacting to schedule and presence.
The logs provide the source label, which attributes the change to a specific rule.
